items.title: CSM cast list omits volumetric casters (Voxel, GaussianSplat)
items.claim: Only Model + Globe set _shadowCastLayout; collections are non-goals; volumetric casters need deep-shadow techniques, filed as NEW-CSM-VOLUMETRIC-CASTERS.
items.evidence: `_shadowCastLayout` is set only in WebGPUCSMCastPass.ts, WebGPUCSMRenderer.ts, WebGPUGlobeSurfaceRenderer.ts, WebGPUGlobeSurfaceTileBuffers.ts, WebGPUModelRenderer.ts, WebGPUPrimitiveCommands.ts, WebGPUPrimitiveShadowCast.ts, WebGPUShadowMapRenderer.js — no voxel or splat renderer. The id is cited by NEXT_QUEUE_2026-07-04.md:101 (demand-gated) and ISSUES_AND_FIXED_BUGS.md:188 (OPEN by design) but is DEFINED nowhere: DEFERRED_WORK.md has no NEW-CSM-VOLUMETRIC-CASTERS entry, and QUEUE_2026-08-09_CAMPAIGN18.md has no voxel/splat shadow-casting row.
items.surviving_record: NEXT_QUEUE_2026-07-04.md:101 and ISSUES_AND_FIXED_BUGS.md:188 reference the id; no defining row exists
items.migrate_text: WebGPU cascaded shadow maps take casters only from renderers that set `_shadowCastLayout`: models (WebGPUModelRenderer.ts), globe tiles (WebGPUGlobeSurfaceRenderer.ts / WebGPUGlobeSurfaceTileBuffers.ts) and geometry primitives (WebGPUPrimitiveCommands.ts / WebGPUPrimitiveShadowCast.ts). Voxel volumes (WebGPUVoxelRenderer.ts) and Gaussian splats (WebGPUGaussianSplatRenderer.ts) cast no shadow; upstream WebGL does not cast from them either, and screen-space collections (billboard, label, point, polyline) are deliberate non-goals on both backends. Casting from volumetric content needs a deep-shadow-map or transmittance-accumulation technique rather than a cast-layout registration, so this stays demand-gated as NEW-CSM-VOLUMETRIC-CASTERS; the id must be given a defining row (DEFERRED_WORK.md or the C18 queue) because today it is only referenced.

reason: Of the 55 enumerated findings (A.1-A.15, B.1-B.20, C.1-C.12, D.1-D.8) plus the summary, action order and backflow sections, 44 are RESOLVED in code with the batch/commit re-verified in the current tree, 3 are STALE (A.15, B.16 not-a-bug; E executed), 1 SUPERSEDED by a later fix that reversed it (B.14, Batch 364), 4 residuals are SUPERSEDED by live rows that already own them (A.4 Vector3DTile → NEW-CLASSIFIER-2D-CV-MORPH/C11-101; A.7 → NEW-MODEL-WGSL-CUSTOM-SHADER/C11-92; A.12 per-face LOD → C11-203; F backflow → ISSUES register), and only four carry live content that no row resolves — B.11 (volumetric shadow casters; the id NEW-CSM-VOLUMETRIC-CASTERS is referenced but defined nowhere), C.6 (WebGPUVideoTextureManager still has zero consumers, dossier only), D.3 (FEATURE_INVENTORY.md:1150 still says 268 `: any`; real count 18) and D.6 (WorkerSceneHost untagged and mis-sectioned at FEATURE_INVENTORY.md:488) — each of which has migrate_text with current file:line. No section is a live authority nothing else holds: DEFERRED_WORK.md and the campaign queues own every open item, ISSUES_AND_FIXED_BUGS.md already declares it supersedes this doc, and the _DOC_AUDIT_PLAN KEEP verdict is a 2026-05-30 record now overridden by the 2026-09-02 ruling. Inbound references reduce to (a) two index links to delete/repoint (README.md:232, DEFERRED_WORK.md:1931), (b) two ID-family table rows in ISSUES_AND_FIXED_BUGS.md (:25, :348) to repoint, and (c) ~25 id-only citations across DEFERRED_WORK, FEATURE_INVENTORY, the parity matrix, C11 guides and 56 source comments, all satisfied by a one-line-per-id definition table (A.n/B.n/C.n/D.n → title, final status, owning record) in the new review; the source comments are C16 rewrite targets anyway, and the runner's `/AUDIT_2026_05_02/` suppression regex is inert. Note for the migrating editor: ISSUES_AND_FIXED_BUGS.md §5 carries three stale OPEN rows (B.8 follow-up, B.10 follow-up, A.13 residual) that should be corrected when its pointer is repointed, and the doc's A.10 path (Sun.wgsl) has moved to Shaders/WebGPU/Environment/Sun.wgsl:60.
